# Copilot instructions for the farm project

- Work within the Django project structure under the `apps/` package and the `farm/` package.
- Prefer minimal, well-scoped changes and preserve existing conventions.
- Verify changes with targeted `pytest` runs and `python manage.py check` whenever practical.
- Keep the repository clean by avoiding unrelated file changes.
- When implementing features or fixes, inspect the relevant app and existing tests first.
